name: Taiwan
change_summary: 民國114年 tables: minimum wage 28,590, 12 勞保 grades to 45,800, 59 健保 grades to 313,000, 勞退 grade 24 = 28,590 → 1,715.40; LI 11.5% + EI 1%, NHI 5.17%, the 職災 industry table in force 2025-01-01, and the non-resident 6% breakpoint at 42,885.

limits.authority: 勞基法 §32(2): 54 overtime hours a month where a union or the labour-management conference consents, inside the 138-hour quarter
勞基法 §30(1): normal hours may not exceed eight a day and forty a week — the hours past forty in a week are overtime whatever the day’s length.

work_rules.authority: 勞動基準法第24條第1項 — extended work is paid at no less than 4/3 of the ordinary hourly wage for the first two hours and 5/3 beyond, in force in this form since 2018-03-01; 第32條第2項 caps normal plus extended work at 12 hours a day, extended work at 46 hours a month and, where a union or a labour-management conference consents, at 138 hours in any three months; 第35條 gives 30 minutes' rest after four continuous hours; 第36條 gives two days' rest in every seven, one of them the 例假 that may not be worked; 第37條 and 紀念日及節日實施條例第8條 move a holiday that falls on a rest day to a 補假 rather than absorbing it; 第39條 pays a further day's wage for work on a holiday. Applied 2026-09-18: §30 the normal day is eight hours (`normal_hours`); §32(2) 54 overtime hours a month on consent (`limits[].when` over the entity fact `overtime_consent`); §35 proviso: for shift or continuous work the break is rescheduled inside working time and counts as worked (`shift_or_continuous_work`); §84-1: a NON_EA classification at an establishment with an approved 責任制 agreement is outside the overtime ladder (`responsibility_system`).

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or beside it for the browser.

Codes: 勞動基準法 N0030001, 勞工請假規則 N0030006, 性別平等工作法 N0030014, 勞工退休金條例 N0030020, 勞工保險條例 N0050001, 就業保險法 N0050021, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 N0050031, 各類所得扣繳率標準 G0340028, 所得稅法 G0340003, 全民健康保險法 L0060001.
law-out.mof.gov.tw — 各類所得扣繳率標準: /LawContent.aspx?id=FL005962 (§2 the 5% election, §3 non-resident 18%/6%, §13 the NT$2,000 exemption).
bli.gov.tw — 勞保局 tables, each a small text PDF at /Files/<n>: 勞保投保薪資分級表 (115年 25659, 114年 24801), 勞退月提繳分級表 (25709), 職災投保薪資分級表 (25664, 114年 24804), 職災 月負擔金額表 (25669), 勞保+就保 分擔金額表 (25697). /0011588.html indexes the current 分級表; /0014162.html is the 勞保費率 history (the §13 two-yearly step).

mol.gov.tw — 勞動部 announcements: /1607/1632/1633/ the 基本工資 notices (the 116年 wage lands here), /1607/1632/1640/ the 勞保費率 notices.
dot.gov.tw — 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 for the year: /singlehtml/ch26?cntId=<id> (the 扣除額 announcement) and /download/<id> (the table).

name: Taiwan — 1 January 2027
change_summary: 勞保條例 §13’s 2027 step: the ordinary rate rises from 11.5% to 12% (13% combined with 就業保險) on the 115年 ladder; the 116年 grade tables await the 116年 minimum wage. The 116年 holiday calendar is transcribed.
